narrative:
The consolidated FY2026 plan delivers operating income of EUR 336M against operating expenses of EUR 196M — a cost-to-income ratio of 58.3%, down 2.7pp from 61.0% in FY2025 and inside the Board's <60% target with 1.7pp of headroom.

The bridge shows the story: fee and insurance growth improves C/I by 3.1pp and NII by 0.2pp; wage inflation (+1.5pp) and change-portfolio run cost (+0.4pp) push it up; efficiency savings bring it back down by 1.3pp. ROE is planned at 12.4%, above the 12% floor.

The main risk is rates: a 25bp lower Euribor path would cost about 1.2pp of C/I. The finance gate passes and the plan is ready for Board submission.

signals.title: Aktia Strategy 2026 — Efficiency & Wealth Growth
signals.excerpt: Board reconfirms financial targets: cost-to-income below 60% and ROE above 12%. Growth priority is wealth management; banking services to be developed through digital channels.

signals.title: ECB Easing Path — Deposit Rate at 2.00%
signals.excerpt: Markets price a flat deposit rate through 2026. 12M Euribor stabilised near 2.1%, ending the NII tailwind that lifted Finnish banks in 2023-24.

signals.title: Finnish Financial Sector Collective Agreement 2025-27
signals.excerpt: General pay increase of 3.0% in 2026 plus local pots — roughly EUR 3M on Aktia's personnel base.
